scope: Proposition 7.13 (Addition in distribution) of the manuscript “Arithmeticity of twisted finite correspondences for lattices over local fields” (preprints/Arithmeticity-of-twisted-finite-correspondences-for-lattices-over-local-fields-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 286 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 b1d070a5c4cd8496), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 77. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let Rn → ∞, let Θn be admissible for T, and suppose (7.24) holds. Fix an isolated source factor and a positive split axis in it. For any tn, un ≥ 0, if the individual spherical laws converge weakly to Pt, Pu, then (7.27) PΘn,Rn (tn + un) −→ Pt ∗ Pu. The same statement permits pre- and post-translations in fixed compact subsets of G.
